subject: Commit preflight: submission blueprint & evidence lane
body:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: ACME Finance <finance@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit preflight: submission blueprint & evidence lane

Hi all —

This is the preflight for ACME's weekly submission. Goal: make the slot on Thursday (6/3) with a clean evidence handoff and stage owners confirmed so RevOps can submit without follow-ups. Short ask list below and a 30-minute sync Wednesday to run the packet.

Agenda for Wed 6/2 10:00am PT (30m):
- 10:00–10:05: quick state: current stage and expected ARR
- 10:05–10:12: evidence roster walk (who owns each item)
- 10:12–10:20: risk flags & blockers (security, procurement, billing)
- 10:20–10:28: owner confirmations & fallback plan (who will escalate if docs delayed)
- 10:28–10:30: reconfirm submission time and RevOps lead

Immediate asks (please):
1) Marissa — attach the finalized submission_blueprint_v1.pdf and confirm the deck version to hand to ACME. If you update, add version note in the Drive link.
2) Neha — confirm evidence_roster.xlsx ownership (who supplies SOC2 attestation, audit logs, data retention sheet).
3) Rishi — any billing/discount exceptions outstanding? If yes, flag and include estimated credits.
4) Priya/ACME — confirm you will accept the current attestation package by EOD Wednesday or tell us what else you need.

Attachments: submission_blueprint_v1.pdf (draft), evidence_roster.xlsx (ROSTER stub)

Thanks — quick replies appreciated so we can keep the preflight tight.

Best,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit preflight: submission blueprint & evidence lane

+1 — I updated the blueprint with the most recent SLA language and attached a small redlines note.
I uploaded submission_blueprint_v1.pdf -> submission_blueprint_v1_FINAL.pdf to the Drive link and added a changelog tab.

On evidence_roster.xlsx: I assigned items as follows and added owner column:
- SOC2 attestation: Neha (we have the letter from infra; needs stamping)
- Audit logs: Marissa (export ready, 1 week retention snapshot)
- Data retention matrix: Neha
- Contract/PO: Rishi (waiting on finance signature)

I'll be on the Wed 10:00am PT call.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior RevOps Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: submission_blueprint_v1_FINAL.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)
-----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 1 June 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit preflight: submission blueprint & evidence lane

Thanks — confirmed owners in evidence_roster.xlsx. SOC2 attestation is on file (Type II, dated 2026-12-01). I will get the signed cover letter stamped and upload by Wed 9am PT.

Quick note on retention: we will provide a one-week audit log export as requested; if ACME needs longer-lived logs we should capture that as a separate procurement ask.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachment: evidence_roster_filled.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)
-----
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Finance <finance@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 2 June 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit preflight: submission blueprint & evidence lane

Hi team — thanks for the heads-up. Quick answers:
- SOC2 Type II doc acceptable; please include the signed cover letter.
- We will need the audit log export and a short note on log retention policy (1 paragraph).
- Billing: we can accept the standard committed terms; if Rishi has a proposed credit number, we will route to procurement for sign-off.

I can be on the call at 10:00am PT. If anything changes I will ping.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Lead Procurement Manager, ACME Corp
-----
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: ACME Finance <finance@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 2 June 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit preflight: submission blueprint & evidence lane — final prep

Great sync this morning — thanks everyone for quick turnarounds. Summary and next steps: 
- Evidence: Neha to upload stamped cover letter + evidence_roster_filled.xlsx (done) by Thu 9am PT.
- Deck: Marissa uploaded submission_blueprint_v1_FINAL.pdf (link above) — use that version for submission.
- Billing: Rishi to confirm credit/PO status by Thu 11am PT; if not, we'll include a note that procurement is pending and submit the rest.
- ACME: Priya confirmed acceptance of SOC2 and audit log export.
- Submission window: RevOps will submit at 2:00pm PT on Thu 6/3.

If anything breaks, flag in this thread and I'll escalate to CS and Legal.

Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: submission_blueprint_v1_FINAL.pdf, evidence_roster_filled.xlsx
Calendar: Wed 2027-06-02 10:00am PT — 30m (confirmed)
notes: Preflight thread for weekly submission; concise agenda and evidence ownership; mixed internal/external replies; attachments uploaded and call confirmed.
